title: Buying his first secondhand clarinet
summary: After trying harmonica, he buys a used clarinet at about seventeen for nine dollars and needs a new mouthpiece.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the first horn: clarinet and saxophone beginnings

blocks.x: Yeah. When you were a boy, what was your first instrument? When did you play on any, uh, even toy instruments, like kin flutes or anything else like some of them kids had?

No, I, uh, I tried fooling with harmonica, but that was too hard to fool with, and I was too hard to learn and figuring not to get anything out of it. Yeah. In those days, most everybody played harmonica. You never, boy, you don't own no record or anything. No. And, uh, well I wanted to clarinet, so the first chance I got, well I did buy a secondhand one. Mm-hmm. I bought a secondhand one from a fella.
How old were you? Do you remember him?

Mm-hmm. And, uh, I bought one for nine dollars. And when I brought it home, I took it and started blowing on it. When I couldn't find out the mouthpiece had a piece missing out of it, and he had to fill it with wax. So I had to go buy a mouthpiece. I went and bought a mouthpiece. Yeah. And bought a mouthpiece. Well I kept that one a good while.
I was in the Albert system, no doubt. Oh yeah.
